clips.title: The endless pad
clips.caption: Four slow pad chords into an endless tail, then nothing more is played.
clips.transcript: A soft synth pad plays four chords, A minor, F, D minor and E minor, four seconds each. The reverb swells in under the first chord and never lets go: each chord lands on top of the last one's tail, so they blend into one slow, warm wash. After the last chord is released nothing more is played, and the wash goes on at a steady level, still holding its notes, until the clip fades.

clips.title: Freeze, then paint
clips.caption: An electric piano chord is frozen into a still pad, a lead plays over it, and its last phrase is painted in.

settings.FREEZE / PAINT: tap at 1.6 s (freeze), held 15.4-20.6 s (paint), tap at 22.5 s (release)

clips.transcript: An electric piano plays one D minor ninth chord. A moment later the button is tapped, and the hall freezes the chord into a still pad that holds its level instead of fading. A soft synth lead plays three phrases over the pad, and the pad doesn't take them in. During the last phrase the button is held, and the lead's high A is painted into the pad: from then on the pad carries that note too. A last tap lets the pad go, and it fades away.
clips.note: Electric piano and lead synthesised in code.

clips.title: Dub techno stabs
clips.caption: Minor-ninth stabs on the send over a kick and rimshot; the endless tail ducks under them and fills the gaps.
clips.transcript: A dub techno groove at 118 bpm: a kick on every beat, a rimshot, a quiet hat, and short C minor ninth chord stabs on the offbeats. Only the stabs go into the reverb. Over the first bars the tail builds into an endless wash that dips a little under each stab and swells back in the gaps, so the stabs stay clear. After eight bars the groove stops, and the wash just holds at a steady level until the clip fades.
clips.note: Drums: Virtuosity Drums by Versilian Studios and Karoryfer (CC0). Stabs synthesised in code.

clips.title: Bloom swell
clips.caption: Single piano notes, each one swelling in slowly behind itself.
clips.transcript: A piano plays six single notes in A minor, about four seconds apart. Each note is dry and close; its reverb starts almost silent and swells in over the next two or three seconds, so every note blooms in behind itself and joins a long, soft wash.

clips.title: Shimmer melody
clips.caption: A slow lead with one steady octave above it in the reverb.
clips.transcript: A soft, round synth lead plays a slow melody in D minor, with long notes and space between the phrases. The reverb adds one steady octave above each note: a quiet, higher voice that follows the melody and rings on in the tail. The lead has no octave of its own; the octave is only in the reverb.

clips.title: Worn guitar
clips.caption: Slow guitar chords while WEAR is turned up from fully left to 2 o'clock: hiss and grain come into the tail.

settings.WEAR: fully left → 2 o'clock, turned steadily from 1 to 24 s

clips.transcript: A clean electric guitar strums seven slow chords in E minor, one every few seconds, while WEAR is turned up steadily from fully left. At the start the reverb is clean. As WEAR comes up, a soft hiss and grain rise into the top of the tail, and its deepest lows thin a little.
clips.note: Guitar: Emilyguitar by Karoryfer (CC0). Played in code.

clips.title: The tape side of MOTION
clips.caption: Electric piano chords with MOTION fully left, the tape side: wow, flutter, crinkle and a few short dropouts.
clips.transcript: An electric piano plays held chords, D minor nine, G, C and F, with a few notes between, twice through. With MOTION fully left the whole tail wavers in pitch together, with quick crinkles, and now and then a short dropout dulls it for a moment.

clips.title: Dark drone, SIZE growing
clips.caption: A low drone into an endless tail while SIZE is turned up from 9 o'clock to fully right in four moves.

settings.SIZE: 9 → 5 o'clock, in four moves (to 11, 1, 3 and 5 at 4, 8, 12 and 16 s)

clips.transcript: A low drone on D, with its fifth and octave, swells in and holds, then fades out at about 21 seconds. The reverb is endless, so the wash goes on after the drone stops. SIZE is turned up in four moves, at 4, 8, 12 and 16 seconds, and each time the space settles bigger: the low mids thin out and the deepest lows grow, while the level stays the same.
